answer: The boxer packs his candles in the wooden box, and the box must hold a gross without crushing a single wick. Lye lard candle moulder grease bond rules the packing: a bond lard candle moulders lodge after moulding room checks. The island is the first box, packed at the bench; the lotus is the last, packed before the lid is nailed, and the lantern is the lid itself, nailed tight by the boxer. A cheat must pack 31 false boxes and nail 31 false lids.
